name: Tu Sooraj Main Saanjh Piyaji
description: Tu Sooraj Main Saanjh Piyaji is a Hindi drama serial aired on Star Plus. Sooraj and Sandhya were the ideal couple. Now, their daughter, Kanak sets off on a journey with Uma Shankar, who is her perfect opposite.

videos.title: Kanak Meets Uma Shankar
videos.overview: Beautiful Kanak has a bad first impression meeting the handsome and rich Uma Shankar. Later, she overhears Bhabho saying that she is not the daughter of Sooraj and Sandhya.
